name: Terrarium
summary: Stranded on a toxic moon, Ortegas must defy her deepest beliefs to survive.

name: New Life and New Civilizations
summary: When an ancient evil resurfaces, Pike faces a life-altering choice to stop it.

name: Second Contact
summary: Ensign Tendi has her first day of work on Starfleet's USS Cerritos, where she meets three fellow support crew members, Ensigns Mariner, Boimler, and Rutherford. Meanwhile, Boimler is tasked with a secret special assignment and Rutherford attempts to keep his dating life intact while an outbreak strikes the ship.

name: Envoys
summary: After a high-profile mission goes awry, Boimler is further plagued with self-doubt when Mariner proves herself to be a more naturally talented sci-fi badass than he. Rutherford quits his job in engineering and explores other departments on the USS Cerritos.

name: Temporal Edict
summary: A new work protocol eliminating "buffer time" has the Cerritos crew running ragged as they try to keep up with their tightened schedules. Ensign Mariner and Commander Ransom's mutual lack of respect comes to a head during an away mission.

name: Moist Vessel
summary: Captain Freeman seeks the ultimate payback after Mariner blatantly disrespects her in front of the crew. A well-meaning Tendi accidentally messes up a lieutenant's attempt at spiritual ascension and tries to make it right.

name: Cupid's Errant Arrow
summary: Mariner is suspicious of Boimler's new girlfriend. Tendi and Rutherford grow jealous of a bigger starship's gear.

name: Terminal Provocations
summary: The lovable but awkward Ensign Fletcher makes work difficult for Mariner and Boimler. Rutherford introduces Tendi to a holodeck training program he created.

name: Much Ado About Boimler
summary: Mariner tries to impress her best friend from Starfleet Academy who is now a visiting captain. Boimler is sent to a Starfleet medical ship after a transporter accident puts him "out of phase."

name: Veritas
summary: Mariner, Boimler, Tendi, and Rutherford are caught off guard when certain aliens force them to testify about a series of apparently unrelated events.

name: Crisis Point
summary: Mariner repurposes Boimler's holodeck program to cast herself as the villain in a "lower decks"-style movie.

name: No Small Parts
summary: The USS Cerritos encounters a familiar enemy. Tendi helps a struggling recruit find her footing.

name: Strange Energies
summary: The USS Cerritos is dispatched on a mission where it ends up in a sci-fi event resulting in "strange energy", which Commander Ransom inadvertently absorbs.

name: Kayshon, His Eyes Open
summary: Our Lower Deckers have trouble bonding with Ensign Jet Manhaver, who has been assigned Boimler's bunk and shift duties. Meanwhile, we get a glimpse of Boimler's life on the USS Titan, which is more intense than he thought it would be.

name: We'll Always Have Tom Paris
summary: Mariner and Tendi team up for a mission to retrieve an heirloom for Dr. T'Ana. Meanwhile, the Cerritos is visited by Lieutenant Tom Paris, much to the excitement of Boimler, who is hoping to meet him. While all this happens, Rutherford is haunted by the mystery surrounding the reappearance of a familiar presence on the Cerritos.

name: Mugato, Gumato
summary: The USS Cerritos is dispatched to a planet to investigate an unexplained sighting of a dangerous Mugato.

name: An Embarrassment Of Dooplers
summary: Mariner and Boimler try to track down the location of a legendary Starfleet party while the bridge crew deals with an insecure alien diplomat.

name: The Spy Humongous
summary: Anomaly consolidation day on the USS Cerritos leaves the Lower Deckers with mixed emotions. Captain Freeman attempts to negotiate peace on the Pakled home world.

name: Where Pleasant Fountains Lie
summary: Mariner and Boimler are stranded on an uninhabited planet with a sentient computer. On the Cerritos, Lt. Commander Billups must prove his engineering abilities to an old adversary.

name: I, Excretus
summary: A consultant arrives on the USS Cerritos to run drills that require the lower deckers and bridge crew to swap duties.

name: wej Duj
summary: Boimler tries to find a bridge buddy while the USS Cerritos crew has down time during a long warp trip.

name: First First Contact
summary: The USS Cerritos is tasked to aid another starship on a first contact mission.

name: Grounded
summary: Mariner enlists her friends on a rogue mission to exonerate her mother as Captain Freeman faces a military tribunal for the destruction of Pakled Planet.

name: The Least Dangerous Game
summary: On a tropical paradise planet, Mariner questions Commander Ransom on how he structures his away team. Boimler makes a bold career decision.

name: Mining The Mind's Mines
summary: On a remote science outpost, stone orbs are bringing fantasies to life. Tendi starts her first day as a Senior Science Officer Trainee.

name: Room for Growth
summary: Mariner, Boimler, and Tendi clash with their arch-rivals: Delta Shift. The Cerritos engineers go on mandatory relaxation leave.

name: Reflections
summary: Mariner and Boimler work the Starfleet recruitment booth at an alien job fair, Rutherford challenges himself.

name: Hear All, Trust Nothing
summary: The Cerritos crew unexpectedly spends a day on Deep Space 9.

name: A Mathematically Perfect Redemption
summary: A wayward Starfleet ensign struggles to find a path to redemption.

name: Crisis Point 2: Paradoxus
summary: Boimler's holodeck movie sequel tries to live up to the original.

name: Trusted Sources
summary: A visiting reporter on the Cerritos puts Captain Freeman on edge.

name: The Stars At Night
summary: The Cerritos crew must prove their worth in a mission race, but not all is as it seems.

name: Twovix
summary: The Cerritos ensigns must assist a caretaker on the voyage of a historically significant starship.

name: I Have No Bones Yet I Must Flee
summary: Mariner tries to get demoted, Rutherford tries to get promoted, Boimler makes a big move.

name: In the Cradle of Vexilon
summary: Boimler leads his first away mission on an alien megastructure.

name: Something Borrowed, Something Green
summary: Tendi is summoned back to Orion for a wedding.

name: Empathological Fallacies
summary: The hedonistic outlook of a Betazoid delegation infects the crew.

name: Parth Ferengi's Heart Place
summary: The Cerritos visits the Ferengi homeworld with the prospect of the Ferengi joining the Federation.

name: A Few Badgeys More
summary: Three computerized villains return to cause problems for the Cerritos crew.

name: Caves
summary: The Lower Deckers go on a classic cave mission.

name: The Inner Fight
summary: Captain Freeman assigns the Lower Deckers an overly safe mission to try and keep a self-destructive Mariner out of danger.

name: Old Friends, New Planets
summary: Mariner faces her past in the season four finale.

name: Dos Cerritos
summary: A spatial anomaly forces the Cerritos crew to face their own faces.

name: Shades of Green
summary: Tendi races to stop a conflict while Boimler and Mariner race to stop capitalists.

name: The Best Exotic Nanite Hotel
summary: The Lower Deckers hunt nanites on a resort... in space?!

name: A Farewell To Farms
summary: Dr. Migleemo cooks up some hot dishes while Mariner prefers hers served cold.

name: Starbase 80?!
summary: Ransom uses too much disinfectant gel while Mariner gets paranoid about curses.

name: Of Gods and Angles
summary: Mariner teams up with a troubled ensign while the Cerritos hosts peace talks between civilizations.

name: Fully Dilated
summary: It's a pre-warp society undercover Girls Trip!

name: Upper Decks
summary: The Lower Deckers have a pumpkin carving party.

name: Fissure Quest
summary: Captain William Boimler leads the USS Anaximander with alternate-reality legends like T’Pol, Garak, Dax, and Bashir to stop quantum fissures threatening the multiverse.

name: The New Next Generation
summary: Season & series finale where lots of wild stuff happens!

name: Lost and Found
summary: A group of lawless teens, exiled on a mining colony outside Federation space, discover a derelict Starfleet ship. Dal must gather an unlikely crew for their newfound ship if they are going to escape Tars Lamora, but the Diviner and his daughter Gwyn have other plans.

name: Starstruck
summary: Even with the guidance of their hologram advisor Janeway, the crew of the USS Protostar is tested when their ship is on a dangerous cosmic collision course.

name: Dream Catcher
summary: The crew has their first away mission on an undiscovered planet that manifests their deepest desires, only to realize the planet has desires of its own.

name: Terror Firma
summary: Marooned on a deadly planet, the crew must work together with their captive Gwyn to stay alive... except the planet isn't the only thing in pursuit.

name: Kobayashi
summary: As Gwyn struggles to find her role aboard the USS Protostar, Dal tests his leadership skills in the newly discovered holodeck.

name: First Con-tact
summary: When a mentor from Dal's past persuades him to use their Federation cover for personal gain, they quickly discover Starfleet has protocols for a reason.

name: Time Amok
summary: When the USS Protostar is fractured in time by an anomaly, Hologram Janeway must synchronize the disjointed crew and save their ship before it destructs.

name: A Moral Star, Part 1
summary: The crew forgo their dreams of Starfleet to return to Tars Lamora in a no-win scenario.

name: A Moral Star, Part 2
summary: When the plan goes awry, the crew must improvise. Meanwhile, Gwyn discovers a dark truth that will forever jeopardize their quest toward salvation.

name: Asylum
summary: At the edge of Federation space, the crew applies for asylum at a comm relay outpost, only for their starship to reveal its shocking true purpose.

name: Let Sleeping Borg Lie
summary: When the crew encounters a dormant Borg cube, Zero risks everything to save their ship.

name: All the World's a Stage
summary: The crew answers a distress call to find a colony trapped in Starfleet's past.

name: Crossroads
summary: When the crew attempts to secure transport to the Federation, they unwittingly cross paths with the vice admiral who is hunting them.

name: Masquerade
summary: Trapped in the Neutral Zone, the crew encounters a rogue geneticist who sheds light on Dal's past.

name: Preludes
summary: A Starfleet admiral digs into the past of the Protostar crew. Meanwhile, The Diviner recalls his life's mission.

name: Ghost in the Machine
summary: When the crew gets trapped in the holodeck by a mysterious malfunction, they aren't sure what's programmed or what's real.

name: Mindwalk
summary: Desperate to warn Starfleet of their dilemma, a daring experiment goes awry as Dal inadvertently swaps minds with a Starfleet vice admiral.

name: Supernova, Part 1
summary: Surrounded by the Federation armada, the crew attempts to stop their ship from destroying all of Starfleet.

name: Supernova, Part 2
summary: As the Federation hangs in the balance, the crew must make the ultimate sacrifice to save Starfleet's future.

name: Into the Breach, Part I
summary: Dal and his friends board Janeway's starship to investigate the wormhole created by the Protostar. Tired of his training, Dal longs for some action.

name: Into the Breach, Part II
summary: Gwyn runs into a familiar foe on the planet Solum. Janeway reveals the true stakes of their mission to Dal and his friends.

name: Who Saves the Saviors
summary: Traveling through the time rift, Dal and the crew search for Chakotay on Solum. With the support of her father, Gwyn challenges Asencia.

name: Temporal Mechanics 101
summary: Although separated by decades, the Infinity and the Voyager crews band together to save Gwyn's life. A mysterious messenger reaches out to Gwyn.

name: Observer's Paradox
summary: Reunited on Voyager and under strict supervision, the gang must decode a secret message their mysterious benefactor left with Murf.

name: Imposter Syndrome
summary: Hoping to hijack the Infinity before its scheduled destruction, Dal and the crew create hologram doubles to cover for their absence.

name: The Fast and the Curious
summary: After entering a Borg transwarp conduit to travel to their destination faster, Dal and his friends find themselves at the mercy of a demanding Kazon.

name: Is There in Beauty No Truth?
summary: The crew detours to a colony of non-corporeal entities, who offer Zero an opportunity to obtain a physical body. Janeway discovers Dal's real intentions.

name: The Devourer of All Things, Part I
summary: Finally arriving at the coordinates, the Infinity crew discovers a hidden planet – and the long-awaited identity of their mysterious messenger.

name: The Devourer of All Things, Part II
summary: On the run from their time-erasing pursuers, the Infinity crew and their new ally search for an escape. The Voyager embarks on a rescue mission.

name: Last Flight of the Protostar, Part I
summary: Thanks to Wesley Crusher's timely intervention, the cadets find the Protostar – but the ship's marooned guardian isn't eager for their assistance.

name: Last Flight of the Protostar, Part II
summary: Chakotay and the cadets devise a bold but perilous plan to relaunch the Protostar. Before the ship can fly, however, it will first have to sail.

name: A Tribble Called Quest
summary: While harvesting bosonite on a barren world, the crew encounters aggressive, genetically-modified tribbles – and the Klingon scientist who created them.

name: Cracked Mirror
summary: The Protostar's reunion with Voyager has unexpected side effects, bouncing the crew between alternate realities – including the mirror universe.

name: Ascension, Part I
summary: Just as the Protostar and Voyager crews bring their mission to a close, a former enemy suddenly resurfaces with surprising new powers.

name: Ascension, Part II
summary: Overwhelmed by Asencia's mysteriously advanced weaponry, the Protostar and Voyager crews take a series of calculated risks that endanger the cadets.

name: Brink
summary: As war looms between the Federation and Solum, Gwyn proposes to lead the cadets on an undercover mission to gather intelligence and rescue Ilthuran.

name: Touch of Grey
summary: Admiral Janeway devises a clever plan to liberate her crew from Asencia's prison, where they're trapped with an angry captive from the Loom.

name: Ouroboros, Part I
summary: A desperate Asencia launches an all-out attack on the Federation that will destroy subspace, while Wesley and the cadets try to correct the timeline.

name: Ouroboros, Part II
summary: The cadets fight Asencia in a battle for control of Solum and the future – but a sudden invasion by a destructive species complicates their end-game.
